title: The protective effect of Lonicera japonica Thunb. against lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury in mice: Modulation of inflammation, oxidative stress, and ferroptosis.
authors: Xiong, Lewen; Liu, Yan; Wang, Yang; Zhao, Hongwei; Song, Xiaochen; Fan, Wenjing; Zhang, Longfei; Zhang, Yongqing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金银花提取物对小鼠急性肺损伤中铁死亡的缓解作用，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Various components of Lonicera japonica Thunb. (LJT) exhibit pharmacological activities, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Nevertheless, the relationship between LJT and ferroptosis remains largely unexplored. AIM OF THE STUDY: The purpose of this research was to look into the role of LJT in regulating LPS-induced ferroptosis in ALI and to compare the effects of different parts of LJT. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We established a mice ALI model by treating with LPS. Administered mice with different doses of Lonicerae Japonicae Flos (LJF), Lonicera Japonica Leaves (LJL) and Lonicerae Caulis (LRC) extracts, respectively. The levels of IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, IL-4, IL-10, and PGE2 in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) were measured using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. Furthermore, the concentrations of superoxide dismutase (SOD), malondialdehyde (MDA), glutathione (GSH), reactive oxygen species (ROS), and total ferrous ions (Fe(2+)) in lung tissues were evaluated. Hematoxylin and eosin staining was conducted to examine the morphological structure of lung tissues. Transmission electron microscopy was used to investigate the ultrastructural morphology of mitochondria. Furthermore, the effects of LJT were evaluated via immunohistochemical staining, western blotting, and quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction analyses. Finally, employing molecular docking and molecular dynamics research techniques, we aimed to identify crucial components in LJT that might inhibit ferroptosis by targeting nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4). RESULTS: We observed that pretreatment with LJT significantly mitigated LPS-induced lung injury and suppressed ferroptosis. This was supported by reduced accumulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines, ROS, MDA, and Fe(2+), along with increased levels of anti-inflammatory cytokines, SOD, GSH, Nrf2, and GPX4 in the lung tissues of ALI mice. Luteolin-7-O-rutinoside, apigenin-7-O-rutinoside, and amentoflavone in LJT exhibit excellent docking effects with key targets of ferroptosis, Nrf2 and GPX4. CONCLUSIONS: Pretreatment with LJT may alleviate LPS-induced ALI, possibly by suppressing ferroptosis. Our initial results indicate that LJT activates the Nrf2/GPX4 axis, providing protection against ferroptosis in ALI. This finding offers a promising therapeutic candidate for ALI treatment.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：金银花（Lonicera japonica Thunb., LJT）的多种成分表现出药理活性，包括抗炎和抗氧化作用。然而，LJT与铁死亡（ferroptosis）之间的关系在很大程度上仍未得到探索。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨LJT在调节LPS诱导的急性肺损伤（ALI）中铁死亡的作用，并比较LJT不同部位的效果。材料与方法：我们通过LPS处理建立了小鼠ALI模型。分别给予小鼠不同剂量的金银花（Lonicerae Japonicae Flos, LJF）、忍冬叶（Lonicera Japonica Leaves, LJL）和忍冬藤（Lonicerae Caulis, LRC）提取物。使用酶联免疫吸附测定法测量支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）中IL-6、IL-1β、TNF-α、IL-4、IL-10和PGE2的水平。此外，评估了肺组织中超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、丙二醛（MDA）、谷胱甘肽（GSH）、活性氧（ROS）和总亚铁离子（Fe(2+)）的浓度。进行苏木精和伊红染色以检查肺组织的形态结构。使用透射电子显微镜研究线粒体的超微结构形态。此外，通过免疫组织化学染色、蛋白质印迹和定量实时聚合酶链反应分析评估LJT的效果。最后，利用分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）研究技术，我们旨在识别LJT中可能通过靶向核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）抑制铁死亡的关键成分。结果：我们观察到，LJT预处理显著减轻了LPS诱导的肺损伤并抑制了铁死亡。这得到了ALI小鼠肺组织中促炎细胞因子、ROS、MDA和Fe(2+)积累减少，以及抗炎细胞因子、SOD、GSH、Nrf2和GPX4水平增加的支持。LJT中的木犀草素-7-O-芸香糖苷、芹菜素-7-O-芸香糖苷和穗花杉双黄酮与铁死亡关键靶点Nrf2和GPX4表现出优异的对接效果。结论：LJT预处理可能通过抑制铁死亡来缓解LPS诱导的ALI。我们的初步结果表明，LJT激活Nrf2/GPX4轴，在ALI中提供针对铁死亡的保护。这一发现为ALI治疗提供了一个有前景的治疗候选方案。
